title: 2009 上海高考秋考 I. Translation
sourceFile: 2009年上海秋季高考英语真题及答案.doc
directions: Directions: Translate the following sentences into English, using the words given in the brackets.

questions.sourceText: 网球运动在上海越来越流行了。
referenceAnswers: Tennis is getting more and more popular in Shanghai.

questions.sourceText: 我认为你们的建议和他们的一样有价值。
referenceAnswers: I think your suggestion is as valuable as theirs.

questions.sourceText: 只喝一杯咖啡就会使我整晚睡不着。
referenceAnswers: Drinking only a cup of coffee will keep me awake all night.

questions.sourceText: 为了纪念那些勇敢的消防战士，一部电影即将开拍。
referenceAnswers: A film will be made/shot in memory of those brave fire fighters.

questions.sourceText: 过了三天她才想起把雨衣忘在语言实验室了。
referenceAnswers: It was three days later that she remembered leaving/having left her raincoat in the language lab.

questions.sourceText: 尽管山高林密，医护人员还是迅速地赶到出事地点，实施援救。
referenceAnswers: Despite the high mountains and thick forests, the doctors and nurses rushed to the scene of the accident for the rescue/to carry out the rescue.

title: 2009 上海高考秋考作文
sourceFile: 2009年上海秋季高考英语真题及答案.doc
prompt: Directions: Write an English composition in 120 - 150 words according to the instructions given below in Chinese. 某海外学校举办英语夏令营，开设了如下课程：园艺（gardening）、烹饪（cooking）、防身术（self-defence）、护理（nursing）。假如你是王跃华（不可以用自己的真实姓名），写一封申请信，报名参加其中一门课程的学习。信的内容必须包括： 你感兴趣的课程 你期望从这门课程中学到什么 为什么想学这些内容
